name: Carmen Teo
reason: Too thin once the health rule is applied: her main work (Transform Heartminds, Singapore) is MBSR, Mindful Self-Compassion and trauma-sensitive yoga, framed on her pages as health intervention and with anxiety, depression and stress named; no events are listed after June 2026, and she has no books, videos or free resources, leaving only the dana-based Mindfulness Mentorship Program and a generic silent-retreat page.
